label: preparing
what: A civic presentation thanking the mayor for public service, with a related private order of forty-four loaves and event setup; it was not initially disclosed to the mayor, who was later told and approved the event on Day 0. The record supports baker and builder knowingly helping through the bread order and materials/payment, while innkeeper organized it. It does not establish that the neighbour, freight, or secretary knowingly helped prepare the event (secretary handled appointment administration).
